intro.title: ABOUT DONG DUONG CORPORATION
intro.content1: Dong Duong Corporation is proud to be a leading and trusted enterprise in supplying luxury architectural finishing materials and high-efficiency air conditioning systems in Vietnam.
intro.content2: With sustainable development principles and uncompromised quality, Dong Duong focuses on two primary business sectors: (1) Ceramic and decorative tiles from renowned manufacturers such as Dongtam, Viglacera, Catalan, Thuan Hai, Ha Thanh; (2) Comprehensive HVAC solutions ranging from 2-unit split systems (wall-mounted, ceiling cassette, ducted) to central VRV/VRF systems and industrial Chillers from Gree & Midea. We are committed to aesthetic excellence, ultimate comfort, and energy efficiency for all modern projects.

mission.title: MISSION
mission.desc: Delivering exceptional aesthetic building materials and energy-saving smart climate solutions, elevating living standards across architectural landmarks.

vision.title: VISION
vision.desc: To become Vietnam's #1 authorized distributor of architectural materials and HVAC solutions, chosen by investors, architects, and general contractors.

items.title: GENUINE QUALITY
items.desc: 100% genuine products sourced from world-class and national brands, supported by full origin and quality certifications (CO/CQ).

items.title: OPTIMAL SOLUTIONS
items.desc: Experienced engineering consultants provide tailored designs for each project, maximizing energy efficiency and optimizing investment costs.

items.title: LONG-TERM PARTNERSHIP
items.desc: Professional after-sales service, prompt logistics, full manufacturer warranty, and lifetime on-site technical support for every project.

pillars.title: CORE
pillars.desc: Dong Duong Corporation specializes in 2 strategic divisions serving projects of all scales:

items.title: CERAMIC & DECORATIVE TILES
items.desc: Authorized distributor of Dongtam (DongTam Group), Viglacera, Catalan, Thuận Hải Vaceramic, and Hà Thanh (DHT). Comprehensive portfolio including floor tiles, wall tiles, porcelain, artistic mosaic, and luxury Big Slabs for villas, resorts, and premium developments.
items.footer: DONGTAM • VIGLACERA • CATALAN • THUAN HAI • HA THANH

items.title: RESIDENTIAL & COMMERCIAL SPLIT AC
items.desc: Distributing residential and commercial split systems from Gree and Midea: Wall-mounted, ceiling cassette, ducted (duct connected), Umatch, and space-saving Multi-split systems.

items.title: CENTRALIZED VRV & CHILLER SYSTEMS
items.desc: Large-scale central VRV/VRF solutions, centrifugal chillers, screw chillers, industrial packaged units, and terminal air handling equipment (AHU/FCU) for high-rises and factories.

tech.title: ADVANCED AIR
tech.desc: Integrated, cutting-edge cooling systems incorporating global engineering innovations from Gree, Gree, Midea, and LG:

items.title: Split Systems: Wall / Cassette / Duct
items.desc: Rapid cooling, 360-degree airflow, whisper-quiet operation, and elegant aesthetic integration into interior architecture.

items.title: Intelligent VRV / VRF Systems
items.desc: A single outdoor condensing unit connects to dozens of indoor units with independent zone climate control and inverter energy savings.

items.title: Centrifugal & Screw Chillers
items.desc: High-capacity water and air-cooled centrifugal and screw chillers built for robust, continuous operation in skyscrapers and factories.

items.title: Terminal Equipment AHU / FCU & Packaged
items.desc: Deep air processing, fine particulate filtration, precise temperature and humidity management for clean rooms, hospitals, and datacenters.
